title: HolyCluster / Users
description: Anonymous browser installations, subscriptions, version adoption and aggregate feature usage.

options.content: Unique-user panels count anonymous browser installations. Clearing site data or using another browser, profile, device or origin creates another identity. Active subscription, connection and request panels are not unique-user counts. Direct web means CAT version `none`; unreported CAT versions cannot be classified. Software ID, device class and browser family are reported by clients; old clients appear as `not_reported`. Version, software, device and browser adoption use active subscriptions, not report events. Missing series show **No data**, not zero. Rates need two scrapes.

panels.title: Active installations
panels.description: Seen during the last 10 minutes. Counts anonymous browser profiles, not verified people.

panels.title: Daily active installations
panels.description: Seen during the last 24 hours. Counts anonymous browser profiles, not verified people.

panels.title: Weekly active installations
panels.description: Seen during the last 7 days. Counts anonymous browser profiles, not verified people.

panels.title: Monthly active installations
panels.description: Seen during the last 30 days. Counts anonymous browser profiles, not verified people.

panels.title: New installations · 24h
panels.description: Browser identities first seen during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Returning installations · 7d
panels.description: Active in the last 7 days and first seen before that window.

panels.title: CAT installations · 30d
panels.description: Unique browser identities that used a valid CATServer release during the last 30 days.

panels.title: Direct web installations · 30d
panels.description: Unique browser identities that used the direct backend during the last 30 days.

panels.title: CAT and direct · 30d
panels.description: Installations observed in both CAT and direct-web modes during the last 30 days.

panels.title: Live identified installations
panels.description: Distinct identified browser installations with an open spot subscription.

panels.title: Live identified connections
panels.description: Open identified spot subscriptions. Multiple tabs can belong to one installation.

panels.title: Connections per installation
panels.description: Live identified connections divided by distinct live installations.

panels.title: Unique installation activity
panels.description: Historical daily, rolling 7-day and rolling 30-day unique browser installations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", daily_active AS "Daily active", weekly_active AS "Weekly active", monthly_active AS "Monthly active", new_installations AS "New" FROM anonymous_user_activity_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: CAT and direct usage
panels.description: Daily unique installations by observed access mode. CAT and direct populations can overlap.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", cat_active AS "CAT", direct_active AS "Direct web", both_active AS "Both" FROM anonymous_user_activity_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Daily CAT adoption
panels.description: Share of daily active identified installations that used CATServer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", 100.0 * cat_active / NULLIF(daily_active, 0) AS "CAT adoption" FROM anonymous_user_activity_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Unique installations by UI version · 30d
panels.description: Latest reported UI version for installations active during the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT version AS "UI version", installations AS "Installations" FROM anonymous_ui_version_counts ORDER BY installations DESC, version

panels.title: Unique installations by CAT version · 30d
panels.description: Latest valid CATServer version for installations active during the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT version AS "CAT version", installations AS "Installations" FROM anonymous_catserver_version_counts WHERE version LIKE 'catserver-v%' ORDER BY installations DESC, version

panels.title: Unique UI version adoption
panels.description: Daily unique installations by reported UI version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", installations AS value, version AS metric FROM anonymous_ui_version_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day, version

panels.title: Unique CAT version adoption
panels.description: Daily unique CAT installations by reported CATServer version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", installations AS value, version AS metric FROM anonymous_catserver_version_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND version LIKE 'catserver-v%' ORDER BY day, version

panels.title: DAU / MAU stickiness
panels.description: Daily active installations as a percentage of rolling 30-day active installations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", 100.0 * daily_active / NULLIF(monthly_active, 0) AS "DAU / MAU" FROM anonymous_user_activity_history WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Installation return rate
panels.description: Share of each installation cohort seen again within 7 or 30 days. Recent incomplete cohorts are omitted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cohort_day AS "time", 100.0 * returned_7d / NULLIF(installations, 0) AS "Returned within 7 days", 100.0 * returned_30d / NULLIF(installations, 0) AS "Returned within 30 days" FROM anonymous_user_retention WHERE $__timeFilter(cohort_day) ORDER BY cohort_day

panels.title: Active spot subscribers
panels.description: Anonymous open spot subscriptions, not unique users.

panels.title: Direct web subscribers
panels.description: Explicit CATServer none only.

panels.title: CAT subscribers over time
panels.description: All reported CAT version categories, including invalid and other. Direct and not_reported subscriptions are excluded.

panels.title: Legacy / unreported subscribers
panels.description: Missing either version field. Counted once per subscription, not unique people.

panels.title: UI versions · count / percentage
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions by reported UI version. Percentage is the share of all open spot subscriptions, not unique people.

panels.title: Active by CAT version
panels.description: Includes development, not_reported, invalid and other. CAT none means direct web.

panels.title: CAT version adoption percentage
panels.description: Share of all open spot subscriptions, including unknown buckets. Not release popularity among unique people.

panels.title: Version reporting coverage
panels.description: Both valid fields includes development UI and direct web CAT none. Legacy / unreported misses either field. Invalid/other may leave a gap; these two series are not a full partition.

panels.title: Client transport usage · open WebSockets
panels.description: Endpoint-level connections only. This does not identify web versus CAT clients, unique users, or spot-only subscriptions.

panels.title: Spot submission request rate
panels.description: Submission requests received per second, including requests that later fail. This is not a count of confirmed spots.

panels.title: History returned records
panels.description: Returned records or samples per second, not requests or unique users.

panels.title: Release checks / download requests
panels.description: Dispatched requests, not completed downloads, installations or unique users.

panels.title: UI refresh outcome rate
panels.description: Best-effort coordinator events per second. These are not unique users and stages do not necessarily have one-to-one delivery.

panels.title: UI refresh blockers and mismatches
panels.description: Blocked evaluations by blocker and automatic navigation attempts that loaded the old entry.

panels.title: Active clients by device class
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions classified by the browser as mobile or desktop. Legacy and invalid reports remain visible. These are not unique users.

panels.title: Device class over time
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions by browser-reported device class. These are not unique users.

panels.title: Active clients by browser family
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions classified as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari or other. Legacy and invalid reports remain visible. These are not unique users.

panels.title: Browser family over time
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions by reported browser family. These are not unique users.

panels.title: Client software over time
panels.description: Open spot subscriptions by reported software ID. Older clients appear as not_reported. These are not unique users.
